name: Despair Oracle Mystery
body:
Class Skills: An oracle with the despair mystery adds Bluff, Intimidate, and Knowledge (local) to their list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: 2nd-lesser crushing despair, 4th-lesser symbol of despair, 6th–crushing despair (modified), 8th-symbol of despair, 10th-hopeless shadow, 12th-greater crushing despair, 14th-greater symbol of despair, 16th–unholy aura, 18th-aspect of the hope devourer

Revelations: An oracle with the despair mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Boon of Despair (Sp)

Whenever a creature fails a saving throw and takes damage from one of your spells, it is doubting for a number of rounds equal to the spell’s level. Spells that do not allow saves do not cause creatures to become doubting. This does not stack with other despair effects.

Channel (Su)

You can channel negative energy like a cleric, using your oracle level as your effective cleric level when determining the amount of damage dealt. This channeling cannot be used to heal undead. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier.

Dashed Hopes (Su)

When you cast a spell with the despair descriptor you may harm one of the affected spell targets per 5 levels (minimum 1). The damage dealt is equal to 1d8 plus the penalty imposed for spells up to 3rd level, 2d8 plus the penalty imposed for spells from 4th to 6th level, and 3d8 plus the penalty imposed for spells from 7th to 9th levels. The damage dealt is negative energy damage but may not be used to heal undead. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 5th level, and every five levels thereafter.

Feed upon Doubts (Su)

As a standard action, you may touch one creature affected by a despair effect. If the touch attack succeeds, the creature is dealt 1d8 plus your oracle level in negative energy damage and the despair effect is dispelled. Additionally, you gain the benefits of the death knell spell for 10 minutes per oracle level. You can use this revelation once per day, plus one additional time at 7th and 15th levels.

Forceful Doubt (Su)

Your spells gain a +4 bonus on caster level checks made to overcome the spell resistance against those attempting to resist your despair spells. At 12th level, you may ignore the immunity to despair effects possessed by the target creatures. In such cases the formerly-immune creature gains a +5 bonus on their spell resistance.

Pitiful Foe (Su)

You can temporarily curse one target within 30 feet as a standard action, making it pitiful and ineffective in battle. While this ability is in effect, the target is never considered to be threatening you or your allies, even if it is armed and you or your allies are standing in a square into which it can make a melee attack. If the target rolls a natural 20 on an attack roll or saving throw, the attack or saving throw is not an automatic success (as would be normal) and whether it is successful is instead determined normally.

Additionally, the target automatically fails all rolls to confirm critical hits. This curse lasts for 1 round per 2 oracle levels you have (minimum 1). A successful Will saving throw negates this effect. This is a mind-affecting curse effect. You can use this revelation once per day, plus one additional time at 7th and 15th levels.

Revel in Despair (Ex)

Anytime you are subject to a despair effect, you do not suffer the penalties of the effect, instead you gain a morale bonus equal to the former penalty. Additionally anytime you are in the area of a despair effect cast by yourself or your allies that affects enemies, you may choose to be affected by that effect.

Touch of Despair (Su)

As a standard action, you can perform a melee touch attack that causes a living creature to become doubting. This ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your oracle level (minimum 1 round). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Wings of Despair (Su)

As a swift action, you can manifest a pair of enormous, shadowy wings that grant you a fly speed of 60 feet with an average maneuverability and a +4 bonus on Intimidate checks. At 10th level, your speed increases to 90 feet, your maneuverability increases to good, and the bonus increases to +8 on Intimidate checks. You can use these wings for 1 minute per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Words of Hopelessness (Su)

As a standard action you can utter a prophecy of failure that instills doubt in your enemies and causes them to become doubting. To be affected, an enemy must be within 30 feet and able to hear you. This effect persists as long as the enemy is within 30 feet and you use a move action each round to continue your utterance. This ability cannot cause a creature to become despairing or hopeless, even if the target was already doubting from another effect. This is a mind-affecting despair effect that relies on audible components. At 15th level, continuing your utterance each round is a swift action instead. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Final Revelation (Su)

At 20th level, you become a force of hopelessness exuding an aura of despair out to 30 feet. Any spell with the despair descriptor cast within the aura is automatically extended per the metamagic feat without increasing the spell level. This extension does not stack with an application of the metamagic feat. Additionally, you may suppress any morale bonus within the aura. Each morale bonus may be selectively suppressed but a change in what is suppressed is an immediate action.
